lenses.label: STEREO COR1-B · μ=10
lenses.title: COR1-B electron-density tomography CR2053 · μ=10
lenses.description: STEREO-B/SECCHI COR1 polarized-brightness observations reconstructed into electron number density for Carrington Rotation 2053 P1 with the archive μ=10 regularization. The logarithmic display preserves density structure across the measured shell. A recorded display-only bridge copies the nearest measured 1.5 R☉ shell through the coronagraph blind zone; the native float cube remains unfilled.
lenses.summary: STEREO-B reconstruction from 4–18 February 2007, shown with a logarithmic density transfer.
